There is:
- Music Competition: Multiple groups get on stage and preform, whoever gets the most applause win: A Revealed Silver Cloak.
- Athletic Competition: The village lies at the base of the mountain, and an ancient temple to the guardian of the village Arkanox, the Iron Titan, lies in the hills. The path is up a harsh path. It must be rock climbed and dangerous wild beasts must be felled to reach the temple. The first group there wins: Belt of Giant Strength (Hill Giant). 
- The Dew Gathering: After an eclipse, a special flower known as Twilight Lilies bloom and produce a magical dew, this dew is sacred to followers of Mani (which many of the Owlin and folk of Archemos follow.) The people gather and hold baskets, with their hands they gracefully scoop dew into the baskets, its a sacred ritual and is used in churches and as medicine. (Twilight Lily Dew: One sip is a greater healing potion, you are able to gather 4 uses.)
- The Lunar Feast: A big feast in town where people use some of the gathered dew to season their food, giving it an ethereal and delicious flavor. This is a highly religious ceremony and they are honored if the party attends. Eating this food gives you a permanent +1d4 to your max HP!

This festival is held during each eclipse, but this time is special because it is the first total eclipse since the founding of the town.

The little boy leads the party to the town square, decorated with pale blue and white lights, symbolizing the many moons that were eclipsed. 

Melantha, as you walk, you hear the voice of Solstice in your mind, "Melantha, I know this place... I cannot explain it, I have been here."

A stern human man in a fine green suit and long coat stands atop a stage and addresses the people (Kenton), 
"Greetings citizens of Archemos! For those who have traveled here for the grand tournament hosted by our gracious King, WELCOME! I am Silas Reed, Judge of this town. Today is the final day of our festivities, and we will behaving our annual games! Please feel free to participate in the athletics and music endeavors. MAKE MERRY!"

The crowd cheers as people toast and start to disperse to enjoy the festival. The first event is the music competition, after that there is a couple hour break for setup, and the athletic competition.

As people make merry, a group of 3 people make their way towards the party, a group of apparent warriors. A tall human woman in light armor ([[Valeria]]), an Owlin with a set of robes and large staff ([[Owlvin]]), and a dwarf with lots of contraptions and goggles ([[Gimble]]). They are a group of adventurers called the [[Valorbond Mercenaries]].

**KOBOLD KNICK KNACK KNOCKDOWN:
- While adventuring through the festival the party comes across a small group of Kobolds, they have set up a stall covered in color and hand painted signs depicting crazy kobolds and hilariously cartoonish dragons. The largest sign says: KOBOLDS KNICK-KNACK KNOCKDOWN.
- Standing behind the counter of the stall are 3 Kobolds: Scraps (Red, the enthusiastic leader and working at the desk), Nibbles (Blue, the tinkerer and inventor, he loves to show off his creations and he makes all the prizes), Clank (Green, the "Strongkobold", almost 5ft tall and swole as hell with a big club on his back)
- Upon approaching the Kobolds Greet them.
	- Scraps: "Welcriends, dwana tryda game!?"
	- Nibbles: "Yes yes! Fancyladies, handsomelords, GOTTA TRYDA GAME!"
	- Clank: "Clank."
- Gameplay: The game is simple, there is a stack of tin mugs painted with kobold faces and a big dragon one at the bottom center. Players make a ranged attack roll, using DEX or STR, on a 12 you hit a single can, 16 you hit 3, and an 18 you knock the whole stack over. The game costs 5GP a throw

| d6  | Prizes                                                                                     |     |
| --- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --- |
| 1   | Stuffed Kobold (1d4 for color: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 red, 4 white)                            |     |
| 2   | Fake mustaches                                                                             |     |
| 3   | Powerful Ancient Stone (Rock that has an enchantment to make it shine slightly)            |     |
| 4   | Legendary gold coin of the Ancient Dragon King Noctis (painted gold wood coin)             |     |
| 5   | Bouncy Dragon Eggs (rubber balls painted to look like dragon eggs)                         |     |
| 6   | Magic Marbles (A small pouch of magic marbles that are magically always warm to the touch) |     |

**ENCHANTED MIRROR MAZE**
- A mysterious merchant and minstrel by the name of Mandoor has set up a large circular tent, calling it "Mandoor's Mirror Maze"
- For 1GP you can enter the maze, seeing magical versions of yourself from potential futures. Mandoor pitches as people walk by: "Who might you be!? Come see your future self, your past lives! Come and see your destiny, will you save this land from a foul demon? Win great fortunes? COME AND SEE!"
- If Ivys approaches, "You my friend, you have a certain fatigue in your eyes. You may look, free of charge. But be wary, you may not like what you see, or maybe you will..."
- If Reister approaches, "Ah, perhaps you could see, stone or metal? Suits and armor... you have many faces outside, but what is within? Go, look, I am eager to hear what you see."
- If the rest of the party approaches, he steps in front of them and stops them, preventing them from entering, "I am sorry good friends, but I have nothing to show you."
- **IMPORTANT HELLA IMPORTANT LOOK LOOK HERE:** He says, "You two may enter, but only after dark, enjoy the festival, gather some eclipse dew, and then you may peruse my maze!"
- When they return, Mandoor is nowhere to be seen, and the curtains to enter the tent are just fluttering in the wind. Upon entering you feel as if you experience a wave of chills.
	- REISTER INSIDE: Reister, you traverse the maze, you see your face, different color metal versions of you, you see yourself as an earth genasi once again, you see yourself sitting at a desk for thousands of years, a slave to your work, you see yourself following Kronos, working for him for eternity. You find in the winding halls of mirrors, a single small golden key, placed in the center of the floor. As you walk you see the version of yourself at a desk slowly start a family and begin his own life, did you leave that behind to be free of your contract? Was your contract even real because of Kairos' lies? You come to a decently sized area of mirrors, they reflect a hundred images of yourself, and you watch as the image of you in the mirror morphs into that of Kronos. 
		- [[Reister talks to Kronos]]
	- IVYS INSIDE: Ivys, you traverse through the maze, the same strange presence following you. As you walk through the maze you see your face, you as you are now. One mirror shows you in black robes, a sinister grin on your face, you see Horus, Kairos, and many other faces you don't recognize. Hundreds of faces pass by, they talk to you as you move, Horus spurs you forward, he tells you that you didn't come all this way just to fail. Kairos begs you to remember, what happened to your daughter, what Shao Daraan did, REMEMBER THE MISSION! He only hurt Tybalt to help you remember. You walk for what feels like 10 minutes, are you going in circles? You eventually reach a large circle of mirrors, about a 25ft diameter circle of open space, the walls lined with tall mirrors, so high you cannot see above them. In the mirrors around you you see Horus, Kairos, and yourself.
		- [[Ivys Talks to Himself]]
	- IF THEY GO TOGETHER: They walk together for a while seeing nothing, Ivys still feels like he's being watched, but instead it feels like the eyes are all around him, not from one specific place. You walk and slowly, seeing Reister in mirrors, believing you are side by side, you both find yourselves suddenly alone, totally lost in the maze.
	- After they have their mirror interactions, Ivys comes crashing through the glass to Reister's left, and beside him floating is the incorporeal form of a dark spectral knight with a burning skull faced helmet
